commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-mpc-safety-reg.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "9258ae41ca50d82e704b67243233a6388b17552b"
printf 'MPC_SAFETY_SOURCE_SHA|%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/mpc
python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_mpc_devices tests.test_mpc_optimizer_mock tests.test_mpc_baselines tests.test_mpc_device_responses tests.test_mpc_physics_integration tests.test_mpc_lab_observability tests.test_mpc_shadow_contract tests.test_mpc_scenario_catalog
echo 'MPC_SAFETY_REGRESSION_UNIT|PASS'
set +e
python3 -m tools.ml.mpc.cli --hours 1 --step-s 60 --seed 1729 --output-dir "$WORK/hourly" > "$WORK/hourly.log" 2>&1
H=$?
python3 -m tools.ml.mpc.scenario_matrix --steps 12 --step-s 60 --seeds 1729 1730 --output-dir "$WORK/matrix" > "$WORK/matrix.log" 2>&1
M=$?
set -e
if test "$H" -ne 0 -a "$H" -ne 2; then cat "$WORK/hourly.log"; exit 71; fi
if test "$M" -ne 0 -a "$M" -ne 2; then cat "$WORK/matrix.log"; exit 72; fi
python3 - "$WORK/hourly/manifest.json" "$WORK/matrix/manifest.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys,collections
hourly=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));matrix=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
assert hourly['source_commit']==matrix['source_commit']=='9258ae41ca50d82e704b67243233a6388b17552b'
assert hourly['synthetic_uncalibrated'] and matrix['synthetic_uncalibrated']
assert not hourly['physical_validation_with_real_data'] and not matrix['physical_validation_with_real_data']
assert hourly['config']['steps']==60
assert len(matrix['results'])==66 and not matrix['failed_executions'],matrix['failed_executions']
for name,metrics in hourly['baselines'].items():
 print('MPC_SAFETY_1H|'+json.dumps({'policy':name,'status':metrics['status'],
  'temp_mae_c':metrics['temp_mae_c'],'rh_mae_pp':metrics['rh_mae_pp'],
  'co2_mae_ppm':metrics['co2_mae_ppm'],'energy_proxy_wh':metrics['energy_proxy_wh'],
  'switches':metrics['switches'],'violations':metrics['safety_violations'],
  'outside_steps':metrics['outside_tolerance_steps']},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
count=collections.Counter((r['policy'],r['quality']['status']) for r in matrix['results'])
print('MPC_SAFETY_MATRIX_COUNTS|'+json.dumps({a+'_'+b:v for (a,b),v in count.items()},sort_keys=True))
for r in matrix['results']:
 if r['policy']=='mpc' and r['scenario'] in ('hot_wet_start','stale_sensor','insufficient_capacity'):
  q=r['quality'];print('MPC_SAFETY_FOCUS|'+json.dumps({'scenario':r['scenario'],'seed':r['seed'],
   'status':q['status'],'temp_mae_c':q['temp_mae_c'],'safety_violations':q['safety_violations'],
   'fallback_steps':q['fallback_steps'],'outside_tolerance_steps':q['outside_tolerance_steps']},sort_keys=True))
print('MPC_SAFETY_REGRESSION_EVIDENCE|PASS_RECORDS_COMPLETE')
PY
printf 'MPC_SAFETY_HOURLY_GATE_EXIT|%s\n' "$H"
printf 'MPC_SAFETY_MATRIX_GATE_EXIT|%s\n' "$M"
